title: Accusative: listen, rewrite, fill the table
intro: 10 tasks: two dictations, short answers, rewriting, a table of forms, pairs and a translation.

items.text: W sobotę kupuję nowy telefon i ładną torbę.
items.explanation: W sobotę: a day after w takes -ę. Telefon is a thing and does not change; torba is feminine: ładną torbę.

items.text: Mój tata czyta gazetę, a mama ogląda film.
items.explanation: Gazeta → gazetę after czytać. Film is a thing and does not change. Mój tata is the subject, so it stays in the nominative.
Sok is a masculine thing, so the accusative is the same as the nominative. You will also hear Poproszę soku pomarańczowego (the genitive for "some"), which is correct too.
Kochać takes the accusative. Feminine: moja → moją, mama → mamę.

items.source: Dla mnie kawa z mlekiem, proszę.
items.explanation: Poproszę takes the accusative: kawa → kawę.
An animal after mieć: the adjective takes -ego and the noun -a. Pies loses its e: psa.

items.prompt: Fill in the forms of “nowy kolega”.
items.explanation: Kolega is a man, so the adjective has masculine endings (nowym, nowego), but the noun ends in -a and changes like a feminine noun (kolegą, kolegę).

items.prompt: Match the beginnings with the endings.
items.explanation: Every ending is an object in the accusative: zupę, kawę and babcię (-ę), dziadka (a man: -a), serial (a thing: no change).
Bilet is a masculine thing, so the accusative is the same as the nominative.
optionNotes: -a is only for masculine people and animals.
Instrumental, used after jestem and z.
-ę is the ending of feminine nouns.

items.explanation: Chleb (a masculine thing) and mleko (neuter) do not change in the accusative. The pronoun ja is usually left out.
